before.requirement: Reach print_object printing a constructed cJSON_Raw member value in a shallow object.
before.reason: print_object delegates member values to the Raw-capable print_value. The public AddRawToObject helper can create that state, while parsed object members cannot be Raw.

after.requirement: Reach print_object printing a constructed cJSON_Raw member value in a shallow object.
after.reason: The new depth guard permits a shallow object, and member printing still delegates to the Raw-capable print_value. The old harness still has only the parse route to obtain its tree.

claims.reason: Both source versions support the same Raw object member print behavior. On both sides, the same old harness constraint blocks it: the entry prints a tree obtained solely from parsing and never constructs or inserts a Raw member.
